overview.short_description: FlowDesk AI is an autonomous AI customer support platform designed for SMBs and e-commerce companies that automatically resolves 65%+ of routine tickets, provides AI agent assistance, and keeps customers delighted 24/7.
overview.detailed_description: FlowDesk AI seamlessly connects to existing help desks and communication channels (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Shopify, Slack, Email). Using fine-tuned conversational intelligence and grounding on company documentation, it categorizes tickets, resolves repetitive tier-1 customer inquiries, drafts replies for human agents, and monitors customer sentiment in real time.
primary_value_propositions: Instant first response times (reduced from hours to under 30 seconds)
Autonomous resolution of 65%+ of tier-1 support tickets
50% reduction in agent workload and support overhead
24/7 coverage without hiring offshore graveyard shifts
Setup in under 15 minutes with zero code required

target_audience.support_team_size: Teams with 2 to 25 support representatives experiencing ticket backlog

key_features_and_benefits.name: Autonomous Tier-1 Resolution
key_features_and_benefits.description: Handles repetitive queries such as order status, shipping questions, password resets, refund status, and return policy questions without human involvement.
key_features_and_benefits.benefit: Frees up your human agents to focus on high-value, complex, VIP customer cases.

key_features_and_benefits.name: Live Agent Copilot
key_features_and_benefits.description: For tickets requiring human review, FlowDesk AI drafts contextual responses, summarizes long email threads, and suggests the next best action.
key_features_and_benefits.benefit: Accelerates agent reply speed by 3x and improves team consistency.

key_features_and_benefits.name: Multi-Source Knowledge Ingestion
key_features_and_benefits.description: Syncs knowledge from Help Center URLs, Notion docs, Google Docs, PDFs, and historical resolved tickets automatically.
key_features_and_benefits.benefit: Zero manual retraining required; auto-syncs whenever your documentation updates.

key_features_and_benefits.name: Sentiment & Urgency Triage
key_features_and_benefits.description: Detects customer frustration, churn risk, and billing disputes, immediately escalating critical issues to senior managers with high priority.
key_features_and_benefits.benefit: Prevents customer churn and catches escalations before bad reviews happen.

key_features_and_benefits.name: Enterprise Guardrails & Hallucination Defense
key_features_and_benefits.description: Built-in confidence scoring: if confidence drops below 85%, it gracefully hands off to a human agent with full context.
key_features_and_benefits.benefit: Maintains 100% brand safety and eliminates hallucinations.

frequently_asked_questions.question: How long does implementation and setup take?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Most teams are fully live within 15 minutes. You simply authorize your help desk (like Zendesk or Shopify), provide your public Help Center URL, and FlowDesk AI immediately generates your initial knowledge graph in sandbox mode.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What happens if the AI encounters an issue it cannot answer?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: FlowDesk AI uses a strict confidence threshold (configurable, defaults to 85%). If the query is outside verified documentation or confidence is low, it summarizes the user's issue and hands it off directly to a human agent without frustrating the customer.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Is our customer data secure?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes. FlowDesk AI is SOC-2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Furthermore, your proprietary business data is never used to train public foundational AI models.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can we test it before routing real customer tickets?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes! FlowDesk provides a sandbox simulation mode where your agents can test common customer inquiries and review proposed AI responses before activating live auto-reply.
